one_liner: Neo4j offers the Aura management REST API (OAuth2 client credentials) plus per-database HTTP Query API (Basic/Bearer) and an official MCP server; the free Aura tier allows self-serve testing.
auth_notes: Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials (client ID/secret to a one-hour bearer token), not a user-authorization flow. The database HTTP/Query API uses Basic auth with database username and password, and also supports bearer tokens.
access_notes: The Aura docs say all tiers can create Aura API credentials. Aura Free needs no credit card (from the draft's subscriptions-page evidence, not re-fetched here). Per-database credentials work for the Query API.
blocker_notes: Per-instance credentials, and no multi-user OAuth authorization-code flow. The partner program pages are for resellers and integrators and do not gate API access.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
No credit card or other payment method required
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
To authenticate API requests to the [Aura API](https://neo4j.com/docs/aura/platform/api/specification/), you must provide a Bearer Token in the `Authorization` header
If you are looking for the official product Neo4j MCP server please find it [here](https://github.com/neo4j/mcp).
